"趣聊" (QuLiao) - A social media platform for sharing posts, photos, and short updates.
18-35 year olds.

        *   Index page (Home feed with posts).
        *   User Profile page.
        *   Single Post page (with comments).
        *   Registration page.

        *   Static site (HTML/CSS/JS embedded).
        *   Relative paths for links.
        *   No remote resources (CSS/fonts/JS).
        *   No target="_blank".
        *   Simplified Chinese only.
        *   Real content (no Lorem Ipsum).
        *   Designed for ~1440px (responsive).
        *   No AI/Lab/Company mentions.
        *   No external styles/scripts.
        *   Format: `===== FILE: filename =====`.

    *   *Color Palette:* Vibrant but clean. Maybe a mix of deep blue/purple or a bright accent color (like electric blue) against a white/light gray background to appeal to youth.
    *   *Layout:*
        *   Top Navigation bar (Logo, Search, Links to Home, Profile, Sign Up).
        *   Home: Left sidebar (Navigation), Center (Feed), Right sidebar (Trending/Suggestions).
        *   Profile: Header (Cover photo, Avatar, Bio), Grid/List of posts.
        *   Single Post: Full detail of one post, comment section.
        *   Registration: Centered card with form.

    *   *index.html* (Home Feed)
    *   *profile.html* (User Profile)
    *   *post.html* (Single Post)
    *   *register.html* (Registration)

    *   *CSS:* Needs a modern look. Use Flexbox/Grid. Rounded corners, subtle shadows, clean typography.
    *   *Content:*
        *   *Posts:* Tech trends, travel photos, food, daily life.
        *   *Users:* "小林", "早起打工人", "文艺青年".

    *   *Navigation:*
        *   Home -> `index.html`
        *   Profile -> `profile.html`
        *   Register -> `register.html`
        *   Posts in feed -> `post.html` (though static, I can point them all to one demo post page).

    *   * index.html: Main feed. Need a post creation box and a list of posts.
    *   * profile.html: Profile header, stats (followers/following), and user's posts.
    *   * post.html: Large image/text, author info, comment list, comment input.
    *   * register.html: Form with username, email, password.

    *   Relative paths? Yes.
    *   No target="_blank"? Yes.
    *   No remote assets? Yes (internal CSS).
    *   Simplified Chinese? Yes.
    *   Real content? Yes.
    *   No AI mentions? Yes.
    *   1440px design? Yes.

    *   *CSS:* Define `:root` for colors. `.container` for max-width 1440px.
    *   *HTML structure:* Header -> Main (3 columns for index) -> Footer.
